status: REBUILDABLE, EXACT_MATCH proven for the whole file (see tests/test_egadave_roundtrip.py)
provenance: Cross-checked against public prior art: https://moddingwiki.shikadi.net/wiki/Dangerous_Dave_Tileset_Format (format credited there to Levellass's reverse engineering) and https://moddingwiki.shikadi.net/wiki/Raw_EGA_data.
Every field/rule below was mechanically verified against the actual specimen bytes, not merely copied from the public source. Fields not confirmed by our own byte-level checks are marked accordingly.

header.description: Number of resources in the file.

offset_table.entry_semantics: absolute file offset of resource i's first byte
verified_invariants: offsets[0] == 4 + count*4 (resource data begins immediately after the table, no gap)
offsets[i] strictly increasing for all i
size(i) = offsets[i+1]-offsets[i] for i<count-1, else file_size-offsets[i]
offsets[count-1] + size(count-1) == file_size (no trailing unaccounted bytes)

resource_kinds.confirmation: Rendered to PNG and visually verified to be coherent tile art (e.g. a 3D-bevelled block tile, a gem/diamond tile), not noise.

resource_kinds.stored_rows_formula_confidence: exact, verified with zero exceptions across all 348 SPRITE_VAR resources in the specimen; underlying reason for the +1 row is NOT understood, only the rule itself
resource_kinds.padding_columns_note: Columns beyond declared_width up to padded_width-1 are frequently non-zero in the specimen (~90% of sampled padding bits set); they must be preserved bit-for-bit, so decoders/encoders must operate on the full padded_width x stored_rows raster, not just the declared visible region.
resource_kinds.verified_size_formula_match: exact for all 348 SPRITE_VAR resources, zero exceptions
resource_kinds.confirmation: Resources 53-56 (same declared 23x16 size) decode to the same recognizable sprite shifted 1 pixel right per successive resource, matching public prior art's description of 4 horizontally pre-shifted EGA copies per sprite frame; resource 57 (same declared size) decodes to a visibly different pose.

tooling.raw_unknown_fallback: Any resource that fails the structural assertions above is copied through verbatim as kind RAW_UNKNOWN (per project RAW_UNKNOWN philosophy) instead of being silently guessed; raw_fallback_count is 0 for the current specimen.

roundtrip_result.method: decode assets/EGADAVE.DAV fully with tools/egadave_decode.py, then re-encode with tools/egadave_encode.py
